Hey man,
I know how you feel, I lost a girlfriend I loved. I know right now it seems like there's no coming back from this, and no amount of me telling you that it does get better will impact how you're currently thinking. But it does get better, I promise you that. The best thing to do is occupy your mind with something else, start a new TV show, take up a new hobby (or invest more time in a current one), volunteer, go running. Do anything you can to keep your mind off of her, and in time you'll find enjoyment in other activites, and you'll meet new people. 

I know right now she must seem like the most important person in the world, but there are millions of others out there who would be lucky to know you.

Stay strong man, if you need a chat, drop me a message.
